title: United States: current-account and primary-income balances (quarterly, seasonally adjusted, 1999-2026) and the net international investment position, assets and liabilities (end of quarter, 2006-2026), millions of dollars
source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, International Transactions and International Investment Position accounts, via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
series: IEABC (balance on current account), IEABCPI (balance on primary income), IIPUSNETIQ (US net international investment position), IIPUSASSQ (US assets), IIPUSLIAQ (US liabilities)
license: BEA statistics are works of the US government (public domain). Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED.
citation: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis, retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, 2026-10-14.
notes: Values as of BEA's release of 24 September 2026 (second quarter 2026). BEA revises the accounts every June: the net position at the end of 2024, first published as -26.23 trillion (March 2025), is -22.13 trillion in this vintage. IEABCPIN is a different FRED series; IEABCPI matches the primary income balance in BEA's release.
